limitations: Uniform positive hopping on H(d,q); q>=3, d>=3; exactly two positive-rate absorbers; single excitation; infinite-time capture.
No noise, finite-time efficiency, general weighted graphs, or three-or-more trap classification.
Related H(2,q) and binary hypercube cases are excluded from novelty.
scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof for all stated integer parameters; finite full-matrix numerical and rational checks support the proof but are not an infinite-parameter certificate. Prior work on spectral projectors, Hamming schemes and one-sink transport is credited; novelty remains subject to independent confirmation.
title: Placement-invariant two-sink quantum capture on nonbinary Hamming networks
